text:
Sofia Alvarez: Quick QBR flag — two partner asks landed. SyncWave (SI) wants a one-off MDF top-up for final integration sprint ($34k). CloudBridge (marketplace) requesting a 7-week announcement runway + $6k tile credit.
Ethan Brooks: Can we get a tight cost split for SyncWave? Eng vs infra vs promo.
Sofia Alvarez: SyncWave breakdown: $22k eng, $6k infra/test credits, $4k co-marketing (content + webinar), $2k contingency = $34k.
Maya Singh: Marketing note: 7-week runway is OK but we need creative signed by week 5 and legal by week 3. Also want a toggle for the tile.
Rajiv Kapoor: Finance note: Anything >$30k needs Head+Finance sign-off; >$50k needs exec. This sits in the zone needing a written KPI plan.
Sofia Alvarez: Understood. I'll draft a 1-pager with KPIs (expected pipeline $ / demo requests), milestone dates, and rollback controls.
ops-bot: Policy excerpt: "MDF exceptions between $30k-$50k require Partnerships + Finance approval and must include measurable outcomes and rollback plan." (https://redwood.company/policies/mdf-partner-ops)
Ethan Brooks: For CloudBridge, what's the ask on tile credit? $6k you said? Any paid media?
Sofia Alvarez: CloudBridge: runway 7 weeks, $6k tile credit, no paid ad spend requested but partner requests featured placement for 2 weeks.
Maya Singh: Featured placement okay if we set toggles and daily monitoring. Need to schedule a dry-run of the marketplace tile in staging at week -2.
Rajiv Kapoor: Finance requires the 1-pager to include: (1) baseline metrics, (2) target uplift, (3) attribution plan, (4) contingency stop criteria. We will do a 48h turnaround after submission.
Sofia Alvarez: Draft checklist (quick):
```
- Wk -7: NDA + partner comms outline
- Wk -5: Creative handoff + marketplace tile draft in staging
- Wk -3: Legal signoff + dry-run in staging
- Day 0: Publish blog + tile + joint webinar
- Wk +2: Attribution readout + bizdev handoff
```
Ethan Brooks: Add telemetry gates: error rate <1%, onboarding success >90% on first run. Also plan to pause featured placement if click-through anomaly >3x baseline.
Maya Singh: I'll own creative deadlines and add toggle steps. Can someone confirm SyncWave SOW covers the eng rate?
Sofia Alvarez: Confirmed SOW rate matches our standard SI rate. SyncWave committed to deliverables in contract.
Rajiv Kapoor: If the combined asks (SyncWave + CloudBridge) exceed $50k, escalate to Exec. Ping me immediately if numbers shift.
Sofia Alvarez: I'll post the 1-pager here by EOD and tag Partnerships Head + Finance. Thanks all. :pray:
Maya Singh: Thx — will review creative timeline once posted.
Ethan Brooks: Standing by for the doc. :white_check_mark:
